subject: [PATCH 51/60] mm: restrict explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY nodes, allowing userspace NUMA operations to target these nodes. It introduces a new function `folio_allows_mempolicy()` that checks if a folio's node permits memory policy and uses it instead of the existing functions. The patch also updates cpuset migration to evacuate private memory only from nodes the cpuset no longer allows.
